slides.title: Panel workflow: acceptance belongs to the run
bullets: Confirm plate identity and assay worksheet before reviewing activity.
Read blanks and reference responses in context.
Flag an unsuitable run before interpreting article rankings.
slides.notes: Original panel teaching sequence retained. Merrivoss annotation: preserve accession-lot identity when results cross between assays.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Panel workflow | retained diagram

boxes: Sample placement > Blank and reference checks
Blank and reference checks > Panel run acceptance

slides.notes: Retained shared panel diagram. Merrivoss addition: tandem-MS analytical acceptance precedes use of concentrations for exposure conclusions.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Local annotation: two acceptance questions
bullets: Accession lot: which material was received and used?
Preserve label, identity trail and handling notes.
An accession lot can appear in multiple runs.
bullets_right: Tandem-MS analytical batch: is this measurement sequence suitable?
Review calibration, matrix controls and qualifications.
Run acceptance does not establish material identity.
slides.notes: The original panel language refers to run acceptance. Analytical batch here means a measurement sequence, not an accession lot.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Before the run: keep the matrix visible
bullets: Record species and matrix on the assay worksheet.
Use appropriate matrix for calibration and reference checks.
An unchanged analyte name does not establish method transfer.
Merrivoss annotation: attach matrix context to the analyte card.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Reference checks: compare like with like
bullets: Review reference response within the method and matrix in use.
Investigate blank response, carryover and unexpected background.
Historical response is context, not a limit unless the procedure defines it.
Keep the original observation when a qualified rerun is needed.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Panel record to tandem-MS record

rows: Link to article and accession lot
Carry limits into the DMPK memo

slides.notes: Training crosswalk, not a change to a validated procedure.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Reporting limits: avoid a false zero
bullets: Below quantitation means no reportable concentration can be assigned.
It does not demonstrate absence of analyte.
Preserve qualifications through concentration summaries and exposure calculations.
Merrivoss annotation: state the handling rule before the exposure conclusion.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Discussion exercise: identity and response
bullets: The reference response is suitable, but a vial label disagrees with the assay worksheet.
Would run acceptance resolve the label discrepancy?
Hold named-article interpretation until the identity trail is resolved.
Record the action in the analyte card rather than silently changing the name.
slides.notes: Qualitative classroom scenario; no client study or numerical result is implied.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Closeout checklist | Helen Marchwood
bullets: Retain the panel workflow diagram when reusing this copy.
Use accession lot for material tracking and analytical batch for tandem-MS acceptance.
Escalate identity or matrix questions before the exposure gate.
Attach acceptance decisions and qualifications to the assay worksheet.
slides.notes: Final training copy, 05/12/2021. Local annotations supplement the shared panel workflow; study-specific procedures govern acceptance.
